column5: Mixture IV used Type I Portland cement 376 kg/m3, water 213 kg/m3, water-cement ratio 0.57, coarse limestone aggregate 854 kg/m3, SSD natural fine sand 868 kg/m3, with no silica fume or sulfonated-naphthalene water reducer. Cylinders were 102 mm nominal diameter by 204 mm nominal length; molds were removed after one day; specimens were water-cured at nominally 23 deg C for about six months, re-stored in water after end grinding, then air-dried 24 h at nominally 23 deg C and 50 percent RH. Those 23 deg C/50 percent RH values are the reported drying/conditioning conditions, not a claimed current state for every reported value. Table 4 is for room-temperature 25 deg C tests. ST-IV-25-1 raw values are mass 3808 g, length 0.202 m, diameter 0.102 m, dynamic Youngs modulus before heating 3.67e10 Pa, compressive strength 51.9 MPa, and static modulus 30169 MPa. Density is a derived apparent-cylinder value: 3.808 kg / (pi*(0.102 m/2)^2*0.202 m) = 2307.041173402 kg/m3; the report does not state the temperature at which its mass and dimensions were measured. The report gives instrument precision but not a statistical uncertainty for this individual reported strength/modulus/density; claims retain Unstated uncertainty. This is one water-cured and air-dried cylinder condition, not a thermal-conductivity measurement, mixture-wide law, design allowable, or generic normal-strength concrete card.
